acceptance: A live pair of overlapping runs shows the newer commit is not displaced, or a note records that trunk.yml's identical use is accepted as proof
context: Added with the change that makes red_streak_start report the culprit as undetermined while an older Trunk run is unfinished. The workflow test pins the key, not the runtime behaviour.
description: site-inputs.yml now uses concurrency queue: max so an older commit's run cannot displace a newer one. This was checked against the GitHub documentation and the existing use in trunk.yml, and pinned by a workflow test, but never exercised on live Actions. queue: max keeps arrival order; it does not reorder a late-arriving older trigger.
